statements.text: Nothing flagged (plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.)

misses.what: The card names the template's new headings but not what they are: the audit-log page attached to every completed signed document now looks different for signers and the company (logo, file name row, 'Document history' pairing a plain-English action such as Signed / Email sent / Document completed with each log line).
